decisions.reason: The proposal is plausible but supported by only one valid agent and lacks fresh executable runtime evidence. It cannot pass the deterministic auto-code gate.
required_tests: Collect at least 200 independently timestamped opportunities across 30 days, including 50 fully costed round trips and explicit rejected or failed observations.
Verify sellability and all Solana route, slippage, priority/Jito, platform, rent, and failed-attempt costs.
Require a positive conservative confidence bound for money-weighted net P&L.

decisions.reason: The semantic concern is code-supported, but the proposed rework has only one independent supporter and no chronological out-of-sample evidence establishing the correct replacement behavior.
required_tests: Run at least 300 chronological out-of-sample observations per strategy and chain over at least 30 days.
Prove absence of asset and timestamp leakage.
Measure holding-period outcomes after complete chain-specific round-trip, latency, and failure costs.

decisions.reason: Separating strategy losses from infrastructure failures is well motivated, but implementation lacks the required second independent supporting agent and fresh reconciliation evidence.
required_tests: Assign every opportunity exactly one terminal outcome class.
Demonstrate at least 99% attempted-capital reconciliation over 30 days and 200 attempts per chain.
Block promotion when UNKNOWN exceeds 1% of attempted capital or execution failures exceed 2% of attempts on either chain.

decisions.reason: The strategy fits current-route economics architecturally, but stale architecture-only evidence cannot establish profitability after inclusion, reverts, gas, builder payments, state drift, and failed attempts.
required_tests: Observe at least 500 opportunities and 100 wallet-specific executable simulations across 30 days and multiple gas regimes.
Measure EIP-1559 gas, builder payments, inclusion, reverts, state drift, route freshness, and failed-attempt costs.
Require positive money-weighted net P&L after charging all successful and failed attempts.

summary: Only GPT supplied a valid report; Gemini was invalid or incomplete and Copilot was not delivered. The architecture-only evidence is stale and lacks measured runtime profitability, execution-failure, and capital-reconciliation data. All proposals are therefore deferred. No proposal meets the two-independent-agent gate for auto-code, and no LIVE or safety-related change is authorized.
